variable {𝔸 : Type*} [NormedRing 𝔸] [NormedAlgebra ℝ 𝔸] [CompleteSpace 𝔸]
formal_statement:
theorem TrotterError.timeOrderedExp_duhamel (H R : ℝ → 𝔸) (hH : Continuous H) (hR : Continuous R)
    {U : ℝ → 𝔸} (U₀ : 𝔸) (hU : ∀ t, HasDerivAt U (H t * U t + R t) t) (hU0 : U 0 = U₀) (t : ℝ) :
    U t = timeOrderedExp H 0 t * U₀ + ∫ τ in 0..t, timeOrderedExp H τ t * R τ := by sorry
